content: The final code-mixed tweets were forwarded to a group of three annotators who were university students and fluent in both English and Hindi. Approximately 60 hours were spent in tagging tweets for the presence of humor. Tweets which consisted of any anecdotes, fantasy, irony, jokes, insults were annotated as humorous whereas tweets stating any facts, dialogues or speech which did not contain amusement were put in non-humorous class.
